Maya: Follow-up from today's infra section 1: supply + autoscale questions here.
Maya: Short list: per-region H100 availability, autoscaler behavior on 5-60s spikes, and Dedicated burst billing model.
Omar: H100 availability is supply-driven. Current plan: us-east pilot late June, eu pilot mid-July, apac trial Aug. Exact dates after vendor confirmations.
Felix: Will Hosted routes switch to H100 automatically?
Omar: We'll prefer H100 for latency-sensitive endpoints when capacity exists; customers can opt out in Console. No forced migrations for pinned models.
Nina: We observed cold starts for ~15s spikes. Any runtime tweaks coming?
Omar: Yes 1: introducing a transient warm pool + "quick-reserve" path to keep minimal init state alive for ~40s to reduce full model load. Config will be published.
Maya: Fallback order if H100 exhausted?
Omar: Default chain: H100 -> A100-80GB -> A100-40GB -> CPU fallback. Well add per-tenant preference profiles in Console.
Maya: Billing for Dedicated burst? minutes or peak?
Nina: Draft says consumed minutes billed at premium; baseline is reserved capacity. Final SLA docs coming.
ops-bot: New doc: /internal/infra/h100-rollout (internal link).
Maya: Action items: 1) Publish per-region ETAs (Omar). 2) Post autoscaler knobs and example `kubectl` commands (Omar). 3) Draft Dedicated burst SLO + billing (Billing). Console to add capacity hint badge mock.
Omar: I'll upload the autoscaler snippet and the debug commands to #eng-infra by EOD.
Maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: closing thread, follow-ups in #eng-infra for deeper techs.
